sources.title: Maine Secretary of State, Election Results 2018: Representative to Congress - District 2, cast vote records (FINAL) spreadsheets #1-#8 (xlsx)
Maine Secretary of State: Representative to Congress - District 2, RCV summary report, results certified to the Governor 11/26/18 (xls)
Maine Secretary of State: Representative to Congress - District 2, results reported by towns (xlsx; town-to-county key and cross-check only)

method: pipeline/patches/2018_ME_HOUSE_d2.py takes each ME-2 ballot's round-1 vote from the official cast vote records under Maine's RCV rules (overvote or two consecutive skipped rankings exhaust; a single skip passes to the next ranking), which reproduces the certified round 1 exactly, and sums ballots to counties by precinct; each precinct's county comes from its county-specific ballot style (so a few townships that vote in a neighbouring county's town sit in the county where they lie). Golden is dem, Poliquin rep, Bond and Hoar oth (no write-ins were tallied); Kennebec holds only its ME-2 towns, and the 1,105 statewide UOCAVA and unscannable ballots, which carry no municipality, are left out.
validation: CSV sums dem 131,194 / rep 133,982 / oth 23,346 vs certified round 1 Golden 132,013 / Poliquin 134,184 (Bond 16,552 + Hoar 6,875 = 23,427): difference -819 (-0.62%) / -202 (-0.15%) / -81, exactly the UOCAVA + unscannable ballots left out. County values are within 0.1-1.4% of the unofficial town-reported county sums (e.g. Penobscot D 28,909 vs 28,930, R 31,014 vs 31,049).
